_about: The games of projects/, in the order the site shows them: what /games/ (scripts/export-games.py) says of each. The screenshot is projects/<name>/screenshot.png. "check" is what scripts/check-games-in-browser.py expects of the web build: the scene it opens on, and after pressing the keys of "press", the scene it goes to ("then") or the actions the game saw ("actions"). "relay" is a quantum relay's address (wss://...): when set, or when QUANTUM_RELAY_URL is, each networked game gets "Play online", a room's link to send to a friend.

games.name: robot
games.title: Robot
games.blurb: Godot's "Platformer 2D" demo, transcribed: slopes and ledges, a robot that runs, jumps twice and shoots, crawling enemies, coins, lifts, a pause menu.
games.controls: Arrows or A/D to run; Up, W or the joypad's A to jump (again in the air); Space, Z or Ctrl to shoot; Escape to pause.

games.name: rpg
games.title: RPG
games.blurb: Godot's "JRPG" demo, transcribed: a slime walks a grassy map cell by cell, picks up potions, talks to another slime and fights it, turn by turn.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD to walk (two at once: diagonally); walk into someone to talk; Enter, Space or a click for the next line; in the fight, Attack, Defend, Potion or Flee.

goal.say: win the fight with the opponent who waits on the map

games.name: arena
games.title: Arena
games.blurb: A one-on-one fighting game: two martial artists, punches and kicks with frame data, blocking, rounds on a clock. On one keyboard or over the network, with rollback.
games.controls: Player 1: A/D, W jump, S crouch, J punch, K kick. Player 2: the arrows, . punch, / kick. Hold away from the other to block.

games.name: chess
games.title: Chess
games.blurb: Chess with its whole rules written in the language: castling, en passant, promotion, check, mate, stalemate. The board shows where a picked piece may go.
games.controls: Click a piece, then a square (or the arrows and Enter). White first.

games.name: drift
games.title: Drift
games.blurb: A vertical shooter: waves of drones and tanks, a boss that turns red when angry, a high score kept between runs.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD to fly; Space to fire.

goal.say: clear the first wave of drones without losing a life

games.name: keep
games.title: Keep
games.blurb: A top-down adventure through six rooms of a keep: slimes and bats, a sword, a key and a locked door, a switch that opens a gate elsewhere, a chest.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD to walk; Space to swing the sword. Enter on the title: each room entered is saved, to continue later.

goal.say: find the way out of the first room

games.name: delve
games.title: Delve
games.blurb: A dungeon crawl down three crypts: a lever opens a wall and the skeletons behind it find their way through, crushers slide to and fro, a skeleton archer keeps its distance and shoots, two levers open the vault. Alone, or two delvers over the network.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD to walk; Space to swing the sword; walk into a lever to pull it. Each crypt entered alone is saved: Continue on the title.

goal.say: open the sealed wall of the first crypt
goal.done: game.message == 'THE WALL OPENS. THE DEAD WAKE.'

games.name: hopper
games.title: Hopper
games.blurb: A platformer: a world map and four levels, a block with a power-up, walkers to stomp, pits, a checkpoint, spikes, a flag; the fourth has water to swim, snow that slides, a ladder up a wall and a hopping enemy. Each level cleared is saved: Continue on the title.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD; Space, Z or X to jump (in water, each jump is a stroke). Up and down climb a ladder. Enter on the title; on the map, jump enters a level.

goal.say: reach the flag at the end of level 1

games.name: towers
games.title: Towers
games.blurb: A tower defense: turrets that shoot the nearest dino, dinos down a road in waves, gold and a base to keep. Alone or two builders over the network.
games.controls: The mouse (or the arrows) points, click or Enter builds; 1 and 2 choose the turret; click a turret to upgrade it.

games.name: bricks
games.title: Bricks
games.blurb: A brick breaker: three levels written as lines of letters, steel bricks of two hits, bomb bricks that break their neighbours, the last brick in slow motion. Alone, or two to four paddles over the network.
games.controls: Arrows or A/D to move the paddle; Space, Up or W serves as it is let go.

games.name: creeps
games.title: Creeps
games.blurb: Godot's "Dodge the Creeps" tutorial game, transcribed: creeps from the border at random speeds, a point a second.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD to move; Space or Enter to start.

games.name: pong
games.title: Pong
games.blurb: Godot's own Pong demo, transcribed tag for node: two paddles and a ball. On one keyboard or over the network.
games.controls: W/S for the left paddle, the arrows for the right one.
